init_DvcliveLoggerHook: create a DvcliveLoggerHook instance with custom interval and model_file path for training runs
log_metrics_with_dvclive: log training metrics to dvclive by calling the log method with a runner object
save_checkpoint_after_epoch: save model checkpoint after each training epoch using after_train_epoch with a specified model_file
import_dvclive_with_kwargs: initialize dvclive Live logger with custom kwargs or pass an existing Live instance to the hook
register_DvcliveLoggerHook: register the DvcliveLoggerHook class with the HOOKS registry for use in mmcv runner configurations
